notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR34: data-name-6 "indicates the status condition of the previously executed DISABLE, ENABLE, PURGE, RECEIVE, or SEND statement" per Table 1. Every statement runs through MessageControlSession#Statement, which stores the action's status at positions 32-33 via CommunicationArea#SetStatus; SetPath, Send, Purge and Receive return Table 1's I-O values. Probes at --std 85: ENABLE with a wrong KEY 40, ENABLE 00, DISABLE 00 then 15, SEND to a disabled terminal 10 (no action) for a message and a portion, PURGE with no portion 70, SEND WITH a zero indicator and no FROM 60, unknown terminal RECEIVE 21 and SEND 20, an unreadable mcs.json 91 on every statement; the witness covers 00/15/10. Overturned by the held-row adjudication of 2026-11-12 (E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/held-85/set4/decisions.json, row 1985-GR-XIV.3.2.4-3, sibling_defect): Table 1 marks 80 possible for ENABLE INPUT and DISABLE INPUT, and §1985:B.2.2 returns 80 where conditions 15 and 20 both apply, but a queue structure whose known prefix is already in the requested state and whose lower level is unknown answers 20 (p1.cob: ENA Q1/SX 20, DIS Q1/SX 20, DIS Q1/S2/S9 20, each expected 80). Every other Table 1 association probed is right, so PARTIAL. kb/Work PB5393 holds the defect.
